The <b>Architect Crest</b> is a [[Crests|Crest]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]].</i> It is notable for its major focus on and synergies with {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} in exchange for preventing the use of {{CrestSlot|Skill|s}}. While equipped, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can perform a unique <b>Craft Bind</b> to replenish her {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} anywhere at the cost of [[Silk]] and [[Shell Shards]].

== Attacks ==
All attacks involve Hornet spinning the Needle like a drill. Drill attacks hit multiple times in rapid succession, but do not generate more Silk from these extra hits.
* Neutral Slashes: Hornet lunges in the attack direction and briefly drills the needle, doing 3 strikes that deal 0.9x, 0.1x, and 0.1x Needle damage respectively.
* Down-slash: Hornet dives diagonally downwards, drilling in the same direction. This deals an initial hit of 0.55x Needle damage and a follow up hit dealing 0.5x Needle damage. Holding the ATTACK button charges up the attack, delivering two extra hits for 0.5x Needle damage each.
* [[Swift_Step#Run-slashes|Run-slash]]: Hornet dashes and drills forwards, dealing an initial hit of 0.55x Needle damage and a follow up hit dealing 0.5x Needle damage. Holding the ATTACK button charges up the attack, delivering two extra hits for 0.5x Needle damage each.
* [[Needle Strike]]: Hornet unleashes a massive spinning drill attack, dealing 5 rapid hits dealing 0.6x Needle damage each, for a total damage of 3x a normal slash.

==Mechanics==
<b>Craft Bind</b> allows Hornet to replenish her {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} without using a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]]. It is performed by holding the UP button then using [[Bind]], with a standard Bind being performed if no directional input is used. 

Craft Bind consumes the same amount of [[Silk]] as a standard Bind, but does not heal any [[Masks]] and is 0.5s faster. It uses the same amount of [[Shell Shards]] that would normally be used when replenishing the Tools at a Bench. If Craft Bind is used while no Tools need replenishing, {{S|5}} will be consumed.

Most Tools and effects relating to Binding do not apply to Craft Bind, such as [[Injector Band]] and [[Claw Mirror|Claw Mirror(s)]] - with the exception of [[Reserve Bind]].

== Usefulness ==
The Architect Crest's use comes from is its focus on {{CrestSlot|Red|s}}, since it can let Hornet use up to 3 different {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} at once. Its unique <b>Craft Bind</b> allows her to immediately use her [[Shell Shards]] to restore {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} to full when they run out, giving her a near limitless arsenal. This comes at the cost of being unable to use {{CrestSlot|Skill|s}}.

As such, the Architect's Crest's strength is heavily reliant on external factors like game progression and proactiveness to gain {{CrestSlot|Red|s}}, [[Tool Pouch|Tool Pouches]], [[Crafting Kit|Crafting Kits]], and [[Shell Shards]], making its power greatly increase over time.

The Architect Crest's attacks are powerful, but can be risky and require charging.

* The [[Needle Strike]] on the Architect Crest is a powerful attack, dealing 3x needle damage at a long range. Heavily use of Needle Strike will require a hit-and-run combat style, which is strong in certain situations, but weak in others. It will also only generate 1 [[Silk]] strand with each Needle Strike.
* The Down-slash and Run-slash are a middle ground between a normal attack and a Needle Strike in terms of time investment and damage.
* Compared to the [[Hunter Crest]]'s dive attack, the timing and distance of the Architect Crest's can be configured to precisely hit a target, with a larger damage potential. Like other dive-style Down-slashes, it is harder to bounce with for platforming than Down-slashes that go directly downwards. The charge pause also halts all momentum, further impacting it in platforming.

Its ability to enter the [[Plasmified]] state easily by crafting [[Plasmium Phial|Plasmium Phials]] gives this Crest an advantage against difficult enemies and situations that make healing harder, such as enemies being hard to hit or depleting [[Silk]]. Its ability to attack from a safe distance with Needle Strike and {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} also helps Hornet's survivability.
* Weaknesses:
** Without {{CrestSlot|Skill|s}}, it heavily relies on Tools and [[Shell Shards]] for damage. Due to this, it is recommended to use this Crest once Hornet has acquired enough [[Rosaries]] to sustainably buy [[Shard Bundle|Shard Bundles]], or when she has stockpiled an abundance of Shell Shards.
*** Some other work-arounds are to use Tools slowly to balance Shell Shards gained and used, or to only use Tools for short periods of time during difficult situations.
** Its attacks are fairly average and slow, further incentivising heavy Tool use.
** It is possible to accidentally use '''Craft Bind''' instead of healing [[Bind]] (and vice versa), so it is important to be careful of which direction is being held while [[Bind]]ing.
** Like other dive-style Down-slashes, it is harder to bounce with the Down-slash when platforming than Down-slashes that go directly downwards. The charge pause also halts all momentum, further impacting it in platforming.
** The Run-slash lacks the followup attacks of other Crests, which can leave Hornet vulnerable if the target is still alive after the attack.

==Synergies==

* The Architect Crest's <b>Craft Bind</b> and multiple {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} slots allow for all {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} to be used more often.
** Many high damaging {{CrestSlot|Red|s}} such as [[Curveclaw]], [[Tacks]], [[Conchcutter]], [[Cogwork Wheel]], and [[Cogfly]] can greatly benefit from these traits.
** Craft Binding [[Plasmium Phial|Plasmium Phials]] allows the [[Plasmified]] state to be easily triggered at any location.
*** Even without plasmification - Craft Binding Plasmium Phials results in the Craft Bind being able to 'heal' up to twice as much as a normal [[Bind]], for the same amount of [[Silk]]. Gaining the [[Plasmium Gland]] in [[Act 3]] removes the need to turn to [[Alchemist Zylotol]] and returning to the [[Wormways]] to refill Plasmium reserves, making this strategy stronger.
* Similarly to the [[Hunter Crest]], the [[Delver's Drill]] can function both as a Pseudo Down-slash, but also functions as a reliable damaging Tool.
* [[Pollip Pouch]] and [[Quick Sling]] both increase Tool damage, with a few caveats.
** Pollip Pouch's venom does not stack, reducing its impact the more often tools are used.
** Pollip Pouch generally desynergizes with [[Plasmium Phial]] strategies, as it will make Plasmium Masks detonate shortly after being used, making becoming plasmified near-impossible and reducing its ability to absorb damage.
** Pollip Pouch reduces [[Flintslate]]'s damage increase and prevents its burn damage, in exchange for adding venom damage. This is overall worse than base Flintslate.
** Quick Sling only affects thrown tools, making it less effective for certain loadouts.
* [[Shard Pendant]] and [[Snitch Pick]] help with gathering [[Shell Shards]].
** [[Magnetite Brooch]] and [[Thief's Mark]] also help gather [[Rosaries]], which can be used to buy {{S|80}} [[Shard Bundle|Shard Bundles]] for {{R|50|}}. Shard Bundles can additionally be stockpiled and even used in combat. Up to 20 Shard Bundles can be held, with a value of {{S|1600}} in total, effectively tripling Hornet's maximum Shell Shard capacity.
** [[Barbed Bracelet]] and [[Silkspeed Anklets]] also speed up finding and killing enemies for Shell Shards.
* [[Reserve Bind]] can be used to perform a Craft Bind if no [[Silk]] is available.
* [[Druid's Eye|Druid's Eye(s)]] grants additional Silk for more potential uses of Craft Bind. Note that Craft Binding will remove all active green blobs.
* [[Wispfire Lantern]] and [[Silkshot]] grant extra ways to use excess [[Silk]] for damage.
* [[Pin Badge]] allows further use of its powerful [[Needle Strike]].
* [[Longclaw]] increases the range and safety of attacks.
* In [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]], the [[Shell Satchel]] increases the maximum capacity of {{CrestSlot|Red|s}}, and the [[Growstone]] gives Hornet additional [[Shell Shards]].<br />
[[Warding Bell]], [[Injector Band]] and [[Multibinder]] do not affect Craft Bind.

[[Egg of Flealia]] and [[Volt Filament]] do not affect the Architect Crest due to the Crest lacking {{CrestSlot|Skill|s}}.

==How to Acquire==
The Architect's Crest is found in the [[Chapel of the Architect]], an area in the [[Underworks]] unlocked with the [[Architect's Key]].

The key is sold by [[Twelfth Architect]] for {{R|110|}}. It can only be purchased after 25 Tools have been acquired.
